# Arthur Labs Documentation

> Arthur Labs builds systems that enable entrepreneurship: HIIE (the AI engine that turns product ideas into operating businesses — CAD, feasibility, sourcing, automation: https://hiie.arthurlabs.net), DEAN (multi-chain marketplace factory), ROSE (centralized commerce), QUINN (social automation), and SUSAN (app generation). This site hosts the company's guides, articles, and product documentation.

Related properties: [HIIE product + knowledge base](https://hiie.arthurlabs.net/kb) · [Arthur Labs](https://arthurlabs.net)

## Main
- [Arthur Labs — Web3 Development, AI Product Engines & Digital Marketplaces](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/): Arthur Labs builds world changing systems that enable entrepreneurship, growing Web2 into Web3.
- [All Blog Posts](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/blogs/): Explore all Arthur Labs blog posts on blockchain technology, Web3 development, DeFi, smart contracts, and decentralized commerce. Comprehensive guides for developers and businesses.
- [Guides — Definitive Arthur Labs Resources](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/guides/): Long-form Arthur Labs guides: AI + Web3 integration, crypto tax and Form 1099-DA, DeFi, smart contract development, Web3 marketplaces and business models, and starting a blockchain company in the Midwest.
- [Arthur Labs Marketplace](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/): Arthur Labs Marketplace documentation and resources for blockchain-powered commerce platforms.
